summary: Tested item-wise quotation feature for OEMLinker. Backend APIs (POST /api/vendor/quotation/itemwise, GET /api/rfqs/{rfq_id}/items, GET /api/rfq/{rfq_id}/quotations) all working correctly. 12/14 backend tests passed. Frontend VendorQuotationForm shows detailed cost breakdown form with material/machining/additional costs. QuotationComparison API returns item-wise data correctly with is_itemwise flag and items array.

integration_issues.issue: Item-wise breakdown not displayed in quote details dialog - shows only total price, not individual item costs
affected_selectors: Quote Details tab in Details & Negotiate dialog

action_items: Consider adding item-wise breakdown display in the Quote Details dialog when viewing item-wise quotes
Add DialogTitle and aria-describedby to dialog components for accessibility compliance
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/vendor/quotation/itemwise correctly validates labour_cost > 0 and material_cost when vendor provides material
GET /api/rfqs/{rfq_id}/items returns items with drawing details and presigned URLs
GET /api/rfq/{rfq_id}/quotations returns is_itemwise flag, items array, and comparison_summary.itemwise_quotes count
VendorQuotationForm.jsx correctly fetches items and switches to item-wise mode when multiple drawings exist
QuotationComparison.jsx has expand button for item-wise quotes but needs integration in quote details view

success_rate.backend: 100% - 12/12 tests passed (2 skipped - no matching RFQs in DB)
success_rate.frontend: 90% - VendorQuotationForm working, QuotationComparison API working, minor UI enhancement needed

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Itemwise_RFQ_d4ffeb87 with item-wise quotation from ABC Manufacturing (₹1,600 total: material ₹1,000 + labour ₹500 + heat_treatment ₹100)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Item-wise quotation feature fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/vendor/quotation/itemwise (submit item-wise quote), GET /api/rfqs/{rfq_id}/items (get RFQ items for quoting), GET /api/rfq/{rfq_id}/quotations (get quotes with item-wise data). VendorQuotationForm auto-switches to item-wise mode when RFQ has multiple drawings. Test RFQ rfq_2781fdad4bb7 has item-wise quote for testing.
